note: Every read panel the client F&B boards name, against the operation that serves it. **A board panel is not an endpoint** — `getKitchenLoad`, `getKitchenSla` and `listKitchenExceptions` are three panels on one screen and one `listKitchenTickets` answers all three. Building them as written would give the contract an endpoint per panel, and a contract with an endpoint per panel changes every time a panel moves.

shapes.filter: An existing operation with parameters. Cheapest, and most of these.
shapes.report: `runReport` or `getDashboard` with a definition. **A report definition is data, not code** — which is why twenty analytics panels need no operations.
shapes.derive: Computed at read time from something already stored. **A stored derivation is one that goes stale**, which is the same rule that made `inventory.stock_level` derived.
shapes.suggestion: `requestSuggestion` with a `kind`. **Seventeen panels, one operation** — the boards drew each as its own endpoint, and six endpoints is six places to change when a model changes.
shapes.build: Genuinely new. Four, all in Board 2's three newest frames.

allocateToOutlets.note: Allocation is a transfer per outlet. **One mechanism** — a commissary allocating and a store transferring are the same movement.

buildProductionPlan.note: **Genuinely new.** Forecast demand against recipes to produce a prep list. Sits on `requestSuggestion(kind=prepPlan)` for the forecast and needs a plan artefact to hold it.

consolidateOutletDemand.note: Outlet requisitions summed for the commissary. **The consolidation is the read**, and storing it would fix a number that moves every time an outlet edits a line.

createBatch.note: A batch is a planned run.

forecastKitchenDemand.note: `kind=demandForecast` scoped to a kitchen. **The scope is a parameter, not an operation.**

getAnswerSources.note: `AiMessage.sources`. Already returned with every AI answer.

getBatchYield.note: Planned against actual output. **`completeProductionRun` records what was made**; yield is the two compared.

getBatchYieldSummary.note: Yield across runs, by product and by period.

getCapacityUtilisation.note: Seats and kitchen capacity against demand.

getComboCost.note: Slot options costed through their recipes. **The cheapest and dearest combination both matter** — a meal deal priced against its cheapest option loses money on every other.

getFloorPlan.note: Same call. The plan is the map with its layout.

getFoodCostBridge.note: The same bridge scoped to food cost.

getForecastAccuracy.note: Suggested against actual over `ai.suggestion_outcome`. **The table built so this panel could exist** — and so a model could be trained later.

getForecastDrivers.note: **`Suggestion.explanation`.** Plain words, always present, whatever the basis.

getIngredientCoverage.note: On-hand divided by forecast usage. **Days of cover is arithmetic over two things already held**, and storing it makes it wrong within the hour.

getKitchenLoad.note: Count and age of open tickets by station. **The rail already holds it** — a load figure is the rail counted, not a second source.

getKitchenPerformance.note: As above, rolled to the outlet.

getKitchenSla.note: The target, not a measurement. Set by `setKitchenSla` and read from venue settings.

getLostSales.note: **`refusedOrderCount` on the 86 event is the figure.** Built 24 August precisely so this panel had a source — *off for ninety minutes* is a note; *and eleven guests asked* is a purchasing decision.

getMakeVsBuyCost.note: Recipe cost against supplier price for the same item. **The decision a commissary exists to make**, and both sides are already held.

getMarginBridge.note: Margin movement decomposed — price, mix, cost, waste. **A bridge is a definition, not an endpoint**, and every domain wants one.

getMenuDiff.note: Two menu versions compared. **`publishMenu` versions them and `rollbackMenu` depends on it** — the diff is the two read together.

getMenuPerformance.note: Units, margin and attach rate by item.

getModifierUplift.note: Revenue added by modifiers. **The number that justifies maintaining them** — a venue with forty modifier groups and no uplift figure is maintaining forty groups on faith.

getOnTimeByChannel.note: Ticket age against SLA, grouped by service mode.

getOrderCourses.note: Courses are on the ticket. `KitchenTicket.coursing` plus its lines grouped by course.

getProductAllergens.note: Allergens are on the item. `?includeAllergens=true` — **contains and mayContain are different claims** and both are already modelled.

getProfitability.note: Contribution by outlet, by daypart, by channel.

getRecipeCost.note: Recipe joined to current ingredient prices. **Never stored: a stored cost goes stale the moment a supplier changes**, and a stale food cost is worse than none.

getReservationTimeline.note: `?date=&groupBy=slot`. **A timeline is a list with a time axis**, and the conflict view sits on `resolveBookingConflict` beside it.

getRevenueVsBudget.note: Actual against plan. **Budget is an input the venue supplies.**

getRevpash.note: Revenue per available seat hour. **A definition over covers, seats and revenue** — three things already stored, and the metric that tells a restaurant more than any other.

getScenarioAssumptions.note: **`Suggestion.inputs`.** Recorded so the answer can be reproduced — which is exactly what an assumptions panel shows.

getServiceMetrics.note: Wait, turn, and time to first course.

getServiceOverview.note: Covers, turns and stage counts — **all derivable from the map plus open visits**, and a separate overview endpoint is a second thing to keep in step.

getStationBottlenecks.note: The same definition ranked by wait rather than by throughput. **A bottleneck is a sort order, not a metric.**

getStationPerformance.note: Definition over `fnb.kitchen_ticket_line` by station. **Board 6 and Board 3 draw the same numbers at different depths** — one definition, two dashboards.

getTableCheck.note: The bill for the visit on that table.

getTablePerformance.note: Turn time and covers by table.

getTableTimeline.note: `?includeHistory=true`. Seated, ordered, courses fired, paid — **the stage transitions `setServiceStage` records.**

getTheoreticalUsage.note: Recipes multiplied by items sold. **The theoretical side of a variance** — computed, never stored, because a recipe change would silently rewrite last month.

getVarianceSummary.note: Already returns it. Rolled to the count.

getWasteByOrigin.note: Grouped by station and by stage instead.

listActionQueue.note: **Already the AI action queue.** `decideProposedAction` clears it — one queue, not one per domain.

listAvailability.note: GET on the same resource. `?outletId=`, with the 86 history beside it.

listCollectionQueue.note: `?status=ready&serviceMode=collection`. Ordered by ready-at, oldest first — **food under a lamp is a clock nobody is watching.**

listCostHistory.note: Recipe cost over time as prices moved.

listExpoOrders.note: `?status=readyForAssembly`. **The expeditor sees the same rail filtered**, which is why no expeditor role was modelled.

listGuestVisits.note: `?subjectId=`. A visit is an order at a venue.

listKitchenExceptions.note: Tickets past their SLA. `?breachingSla=true` over the same rail — **an exception is a ticket, not a different kind of thing.**

listKitchenRecommendations.note: The same, scoped to a kitchen.

listTableRecommendations.note: The same, scoped to the floor.

listTables.note: **The map is the list.** A table map returns every table with its state; a separate list endpoint is the same rows without the geometry.

listWaitlist.note: The list is a GET on the same resource. `?status=waiting,notified`.

printPrepSheets.note: A render of the plan. **Not an endpoint** — the same rule that made `printOrderLabel` the exception, and it is the exception because of allergens.

publishDemandPlan.note: `kind=demandForecast`, then `recordSuggestionOutcome` when the venue commits to it — **publishing a plan is accepting a suggestion**, and that is the label a model trains on.

queueAction.note: **A suggestion becomes a proposed action and the queue is already there.** One queue, not one per domain.

recalculateNutrition.note: Nutrition summed from ingredients. **Recomputed on recipe change, not stored** — a stored figure survives a recipe edit and becomes a false label.

releaseProductionPlan.note: **Genuinely new.** A plan becomes production runs. **Separate from building it because a plan is edited before it is released**, and a plan that creates runs as it is drafted creates runs nobody asked for.

scheduleCommissaryRun.note: A commissary run is a production run at a central kitchen. `?locationKind=commissary`.

setSubstitutionRules.note: **Genuinely new.** What may replace what, and under what conditions — and it is the input `verifyAllergens` checks against.

verifyAllergens.note: **Genuinely new, and the one that matters in this frame.** A substituted ingredient changes the allergen claim, and BL-127 built allergens without linking substitution. **A dish declared nut-free after a substitution nobody checked is the failure this prevents.**
